title: Rhyme and syllables
examples: Teacher, what words sound the same at the end?
How do I know how many beats are in a word?

explain.say: Listen to these two words. cat and mat. Do they sound the same at the end?
These words are called rhyming words. They have the same ending sound. Can you say cat and mat together?
Now let us clap the syllables. ba-na-na. How many claps do you hear in banana?
We clap for each beat in the word. apple has two claps. clap clap. Can you clap for your name?
Look at these three pictures. dog, sun, and log. Which one does not rhyme with the others?
When you sing a song, the rhyming words make it sound fun. The syllables help you know where to put the beats when you sing. It makes the song sound much better.

faq.a: A rhyming family is a group of words that sound the same at the end. For example, cup and pup belong to the -up family.

faq.q: How do I know how many syllables a word has?
faq.a: You clap the word out slowly. Each clap makes one syllable. For instance, el-e-phant has three claps.

faq.q: What does 'odd one out' mean in phonics?
faq.a: It means finding the word that does not fit with the others. It usually does not rhyme or has a different number of sounds.

faq.q: Do all rhyming words have the same number of syllables?
faq.a: Not always, but often they do. For example, rain and pain both have one syllable. This helps us guess the rhyming word.
asks: Must they have the same beats?

faq.q: If I say 'table', how many syllables is that?
faq.a: You would clap ta-ble. That is two claps. So the word table has two syllables.

facts: Rhyming words have matching ending sounds.
A syllable is one beat or one sound in a word.
Clapping is a good way to count syllables.
Rhyming families group words by their ending sound.

quiz.why: Like rhymes with bike because they both end with the /ike/ sound.

wrong.1: This word has a different ending sound.
wrong.2: This word has extra sounds that change the rhyme.
wrong.3: This word has a different vowel sound.

quiz.say: How many syllables are in the word 'butterfly'?
quiz.why: You clap but-ter-fly. That makes three clear beats.

wrong.0: The word is too long to have only one sound.
wrong.2: You are missing the second beat in the middle.
wrong.3: You are adding extra sounds to the word.

quiz.say: Which word is the odd one out: tree, bee, car, knee?
quiz.why: Tree, bee, and knee all rhyme with each other. Car has a different ending sound.

wrong.1: This word rhymes with bee and knee.
wrong.2: This word rhymes with tree and knee.
wrong.3: This word rhymes with tree and bee.
